name: The Windshapers

angles.text: As a shaman, you may commune with the elements through training, but skysight can appear in others too. The Windshapers share this spiritual duty with elemental callers.
As a Skyborne, you know the Windshapers fight for the Shen'dorei's survival and home amid the perils of Skywall and Zephras.

faq.answer: The Windshapers commune with the wind spirits and protect the Shen'dorei. Guided by Illaya Amberwind, they seek people gifted with skysight to restore their bond with the spirits and preserve their imperiled homeland.

Skysight is an inborn spiritual sensitivity that lets a person connect with the aerial elements. Formal shaman training is not needed, but commanding skysight is essential to reaching the spirits of the winds.

Illaya Amberwind guides the Windshapers and recognizes spiritual gifts in travelers. She welcomes those with skysight and explains the order's work, the peril facing Zephras, and the trials confronting the Shen'dorei.
Zephras is an aerial land or settlement enduring severe hardships and internal unrest. The Windshapers struggle to protect it and preserve a future for their people there.
The Al'Aketh are a hostile faction within, troubling the Windshapers and the Shen'dorei. Their threat adds to the dangers of surviving within Skywall.

The Shen'dorei are the people the Windshapers seek to protect. The Al'Aketh and perilous conditions in Skywall threaten their survival, so the Windshapers seek to secure it by restoring balance with the winds.

sections.body: Illaya Amberwind welcomes new recruits into the Windshapers, who commune with the wind spirits and protect the Shen'dorei. The order seeks those born with spiritual perception. They hope to mend the growing rift between their people and the elemental forces that sustain their aerial realm. Every Windshaper bears that burden.
sections.title: Mandate of the Windshapers

sections.body: The Al'Aketh bring turmoil within Skywall, and the elemental plane holds dangers of its own. The Windshapers believe Zephras can endure and the Shen'dorei can weather the storm only if they restore their bond with the spirits of the winds.
sections.title: Trials on Zephras

summary: Among the wind spirits, The Windshapers seek a way to keep Zephras and the Shen'dorei alive. Illaya Amberwind welcomes new recruits to their work, as dangers gather in Skywall.
